title: roshambo-score-v2-reconstruction
comment: Reconstructed storyline of the reference score: 7 story acts mapped to 5 music sections. Acts 1-3 (setup/problem/idea) share the calm opening; act 4 (failures) is tense with a damp on 'Two databases. Same cluster.' (~1:24); act 5 (the big test) comes alive; act 6 (the game) drives underneath the voiceover; act 7 (timelapse, 2D->3D morph, closing card) peaks 2:34-2:50 and bows out on bells.

sections.comment: Acts 1-3: quiet, sparse, almost nothing, slow build
Act 4: muffled, light tension, damp at ~1:24
Act 6: energy, drive, stays behind the voiceover
Act 7: epic peak 2:34-2:50, then dignified decay

events.comment: Gaussian duck on 'Two databases. Same cluster.' (~1:24)
Closing card: drums/bass/lead drop, bells fade out
